list.item: Pernicious anemia with B12 deficiency neuropathy (reduced vibration and proprioception in the feet); synthetic modern diagnosis linked to the documented 1926 cause of death: active, confirmed [S]
Chronic low back pain, mechanical, without radiculopathy; synthetic modern problem linked to the documented 1901 train collision and 1922 automobile accident: active, confirmed [S]

Intramuscular cyanocobalamin 1000 micrograms daily for one week, weekly for four weeks, then monthly for life. Guideline: Vitamin B12 Deficiency: Recognition and Management. Am Fam Physician 2017;96(6):384-389 (2017); Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of cobalamin and folate disorders (2014); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, anemia monograph (2026) [S]

Hematology consultation to confirm pernicious anemia, review the cytopenias and neurologic findings, and advise on replacement and gastric risk. Guideline: Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of cobalamin and folate disorders (2014); AGA Clinical Practice Update on the Diagnosis and Management of Atrophic Gastritis: Expert Review (2021) [S]

Monitor the response on the CMID schedule: reticulocytes at one week, potassium during early replacement, blood count and MMA at eight weeks, and a neurologic examination at each visit; no routine repeat B12 level. Guideline: Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of cobalamin and folate disorders (2014); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, anemia monograph (2026) [S]

Chronic low back pain: eight weeks of supervised exercise therapy and a home program, heat, and tai chi; an NSAID as needed once the platelet count is normal; no imaging without red flags. Guideline: Noninvasive Treatments for Acute, Subacute, and Chronic Low Back Pain: A Clinical Practice Guideline From the American College of Physicians (2017) [S]

Fall prevention: neuropathy and gait checks at each visit, strength and balance exercise, night lights, and home-safety review. Guideline: Falls Prevention in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: Interventions (2024); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, anemia monograph (2026) [S]
